text: 1）Essential conditionApplicants with foreign valid passport and friendly to P.R.China2）For Current Degree studentsA. Full-time undergraduate students of GDUT,under the age of 40.B. Have been studied GDUT over 1 year, abide by Chinese law, regulations as well as university rules.C. Good performance in both study and moralities, with a high attendance rate, obtaining an excellent grade in every required course.D. Have not obtained any other scholarships in the same academic year in China.3）For New Degree studentsA. Applicants who intend to pursue degree in GDUT with specific study plan.B. The applicants who intend to pursue bachelor degree in GDUT, must be under the age of 30, and high school diploma, official transcript, recommendation letters by principal of high school and teacher respectively are required; if the applicant obtain diploma above high school, required documents include transcript and two recommendation letters by professors or associate professor of graduate school.C. The applicants who intend to pursue master degree in GDUT must be under the age of 35 with bachelor degree, official transcript and two recommendation letters by professors or associate professor of graduate school are requested.D. The applicants who intend to pursue doctoral degree in GDUT must be under the age of 40 with master degree, official transcript and two recommendation letters are requested.
